svg.title: How the size policy chooses fills in this band
svg.desc: Mobile diagram of the current encoder algorithm. All four colors have twelve pixels. Ordered span nodes are walked greedily; the first nonoverlapping sweep fills palette one and palette three, and the next sweep writes the remaining palette-zero and palette-two masks exactly.
svg.text: How size picks fills in this band
Input: all four colors have 12 pixels
start x ascending; farther end x first
Write exact masks to repair the temporary paint.
